tabs.html:
Ruijie RG-EW1800GX PRO 1800M Wi-Fi 6 Dual-Band Gigabit Mesh Router


Upgrade your network with the Ruijie RG-EW1800GX PRO – a high-performance Wi-Fi 6 dual-band mesh router built for speed, coverage, and reliability. With combined wireless speeds of up to 1800 Mbps (574 Mbps on 2.4 GHz and 1201 Mbps on 5 GHz), this router ensures smooth 4K streaming, lag-free gaming, and seamless internet across your home or office.


Key Features:


  • Wi-Fi 6 Technology (802.11ax): Delivers faster speeds, reduced latency, and higher device capacity.
  • Dual-Band Gigabit Performance: Simultaneously supports 2.4GHz and 5GHz bands for optimized connectivity.
  • Reyee Mesh Support: Easily expand coverage with one-click Reyee Mesh pairing.
  • OFDMA & MU-MIMO: Efficiently handles multiple devices without slowing down.
  • Beamforming & BSS Coloring: Boosts signal strength and reduces interference from nearby networks.
  • 4 High-Gain Antennas: Wider, stronger Wi-Fi signal for large homes or offices.
  • Smart App Management: Configure and monitor your network anytime via the Reyee Router App.
  • Multiple Modes: Use as a router, repeater, access point, or WISP based on your needs.
  • Supports IPv6 and VPN: Secure and future-ready networking.


Technical Specifications:


  • Speed: Up to 1800 Mbps (574 Mbps + 1201 Mbps)
  • Ports: 1 x Gigabit WAN, 4 x Gigabit LAN
  • Antennas: 4 External Omnidirectional
  • RAM/Storage: 256MB RAM / 16MB Flash
  • Power Supply: DC 12V/1.5A
  • Dimensions: 180 x 180 x 30 mm
  • Weight: 0.55 kg
